hooks.command: R="$FACTORY_PROJECT_DIR"; [ -f "$R/.loki/loki.json" ] || git -C "$R" cat-file -e HEAD:.loki/loki.json 2>/dev/null || [ -z "$(git -C "$R" rev-list -1 --all -- .loki/loki.json 2>/dev/null)" ] || { printf '%s\n' 'loki: .loki/loki.json is not on this branch; Loki did not check this' >&2; exit 0; }; loki --root "$FACTORY_PROJECT_DIR" protect --harness factory || { printf '%s\n' 'loki: hook command failed' >&2; exit 2; }
